title: That Which is Not-Self
html:

  • 2. Aniccavagga 2. Impermanence

Yadanattāsutta That Which is Not-Self

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Rūpaṁ, bhikkhave, anattā. “Mendicants, form is not-self. Yadanattā taṁ ‘netaṁ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṁ yathābhūtaṁ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṁ. And what’s not-self should be truly seen with right understanding like this: ‘This is not mine, I am not this, this is not my self.’

Vedanā anattā … Feeling is not-self …

saññā anattā … Perception is not-self …

saṅkhārā anattā … Choices are not-self …

viññāṇaṁ anattā. Consciousness is not-self. Yadanattā taṁ ‘netaṁ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṁ yathābhūtaṁ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṁ. And what’s not-self should be truly seen with right understanding like this: ‘This is not mine, I am not this, this is not my self.’

Evaṁ passaṁ, bhikkhave …pe… Seeing this … nāparaṁ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti. They understand: ‘… there is nothing further for this place.’”

Chaṭṭhaṁ.
